packages.title: Events, session features and extension events

qualityGates.perWave: merge, refresh pins, all suites green, Linux dry run

wave1.gate: all release suites, Rpc, Sessions, Tools and the four new parity suites green

carryover.item: lone surrogates on input: RPC input and tool-call arguments become U+FFFD; session lines containing one are refused
JSON nesting depth 64 on session records, RPC input and streamed tool-call arguments
fractional usage token counts refused (Bedrock reads them as 0)
byte memory bounds Pi does not have: 64 MiB session line and file, 16/64 MiB stream event/total, 8 MiB tool result, 32 MiB RPC record
Google function calls without a name fail the stream; upstream records name ""
extension sendMessage with triggerTurn from inside a command handler runs after the handler returns; dropped after about 30 s; untested
user bash start failures: Windows answers "RPC command failed.", Unix records the shell's exit 127 output, where upstream reports Node's spawn error
Linux X11 clipboard: no native helper, xclip or xsel required
-e package sources contribute extensions but not their skills, prompts or themes (PiResourceRequest.ExtensionSources is never set)
pisharp mcp is routed before PiCommand: no --offline/PI_OFFLINE, httpProxy or PI_CODING_AGENT environment setup
llama.cpp router discovery and /llama (upstream extensions/llama); native C# extensions cannot register classifier or image providers

project_trust and resources_discover are not dispatched to native C# extensions; compatibility/extensions/event-catalog.v1.1.0.overlay.json still marks the agent-loop topics WireOnlyNotDispatchedToExtensions
/bug uploads reports to Pi's developers (Earendil, Radius gateway) as upstream does; decide whether PiSharp should keep that
samples/extensions ship no pisharp-extension.json and target the older package loader

wave2.followUps: IMPL-F (untrusted projects keep tools, MCP trust, rg/fd, Unix bash) and IMPL-H (mid-run MCP publication, in-call waits, step-up sign-in) merged

wave3.followUps: IMPL-I follow-up (live model switching, extension UI, changelog) and IMPL-E rounds 2-3 (real Pi packages, native C# extensions, provider OAuth, reload rebuild, Linux fixes) merged

wave4.burnDown: merged 2026-10-09 (agent-loop boundaries, exact errors, caps removed, session format, Vertex ADC, highlighting, Mermaid); integrity pins refreshed
wave4.reassessment: 2026-10-09: Parity page, website docs, applicability matrix (parity.* rows per package), 1.1.0.2 changelog and release notes

release.changelog: website/src/content/changelog/1.1.0.2.md (status in-progress, no date; set to released with the date at tag time)
release.tag: not created; the owner confirms the tag

messageCaps.notes: Transcript message-count caps lifted on every provider route, the agent loop and the session reader (PiRequestBudget.RequestMessages/RequestItems); 2,000-message regression on 15 routes.
